findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler can no longer be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler but its body is just `pass`, so it does not implement the abstract members counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. Detector.detector_handler does `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, which will now raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler` instead of returning a handler that evaluates to no results as before. Any detector of type metric_alert_fire processed through process_detectors will crash rather than be skipped/handled.

findings.title: Stateful evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate now returns `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`, but its docstring still says it 'returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult'. This contradicts the new dict-keyed contract introduced by this PR and can mislead implementers/callers about deduplication by group key.

findings.title: Multi-group test builds expected occurrence for group_2 with the wrong value
findings.body: In test_state_results_multi_group the packet has group_2 value 10, but the expected occurrence/event for group_2 is built by calling build_mock_occurrence_and_event(..., "group_2", 6, ...) with group_1's value 6. The test only passes because build_mock_occurrence_and_event ignores `value` entirely, so it cannot catch a regression where StatefulDetectorHandler passes the wrong per-group value to build_occurrence_and_event_data; other TestEvaluate cases similarly expect value 6 while evaluating 8/100. The expected construction should use each group's actual value (and ideally assert the hook receives it).
